Outpatient, Telehealth, & Mental Health Therapy

At Total Family Solutions, we provide high-quality mental health and behavioral services designed to meet the unique needs of children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families. Our therapy services are short-term, solution-focused, and strength-based, helping clients build resilience, improve relationships, and achieve personal and family goals.

We offer flexible care options, including both in-office outpatient services and secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth sessions, making it easier for clients to access the support they need, wherever they are. Each treatment plan is individually tailored to address the specific challenges and goals of every client, ensuring therapy is personalized, effective, and meaningful.

Whether working with children and teens, supporting adults through life transitions, or helping families and couples strengthen communication and connections, our team provides compassionate guidance and practical tools to foster growth, healing, and lasting positive change.

Outpatient Services

Our outpatient services are provided at our Ocala office, where clients receive in-person, individualized therapy in a safe and welcoming environment. This option allows for direct, face-to-face interaction with licensed therapists who develop tailored treatment plans for children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families. Outpatient therapy emphasizes short-term, solution-focused approaches while utilizing each client’s strengths to foster emotional growth, resilience, and improved relationships. By offering consistent, structured support in a professional setting, our outpatient services help clients achieve meaningful and lasting change.

Telehealth Therapy Services

Telehealth services at Total Family Solutions provide the same high-quality therapy as our in-office sessions but through a secure, HIPAA-compliant online platform. This option allows clients to connect with their therapists from the comfort of their homes or other convenient locations, making mental health care more accessible for busy families or those with mobility or travel limitations. Telehealth therapy is tailored to meet each client’s individual needs, using solution-focused, strength-based approaches to support emotional growth, resilience, and positive change in children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families.
